name: More Stratagem Slots
description: Allows up to 20 stratagem slots up from the default 4 to be selected in the loadout screen. Q/E or MWHEEL UP/DOWN to switch pages. You can switch pages at any time. To stop pages from switching while a stratagem is in your hand or being called in, set `page_lock = on` in the settings INI file (`more-stratagem-slots.ini`).
